question: Who among the following won the 10th National Ice Hockey Championship trophy in Gulmarg in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indo Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)**__.

__
 
• **Indo Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) won the 10th National Ice Hockey Championship trophy in Gulmarg in January 2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **10th National Ice Hockey Championship:**

 
 
• The tournament was organized by the **Ice Hockey Association of India (IHAI)**. 
 
• It was won by Indo Tibetan Border Police (ITBP).
 
• ITBP **defeated Ladakh**. 
 
• The match was held at **Gulmarg Ice Rink. **
 
• The championship was held at an altitude of 8,694-feet and temperatures below freezing point.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indo Tibetan Border Police (ITBP):**

 
 
• **Founded**: **24 October 1962**.
 
• **Headquarters**: New Delhi, India.
 
 
 
• **Ice Hockey Association of India:**
 
 
• It is a governing body of ice hockey in India. 
 
• The association became a member of the **International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF)** in the year **1989**.
